title: Colombia to Start Aerial Spraying of Coca Crops Despite Health Worries
summary_full: The plan — quickly challenged by a local court — came days after Colombia’s president and the U.S. secretary of state, Marco Rubio, discussed stronger measures against drug trafficking.
